name: jjm_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP for Jal Jeevan Mission authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.

name: jjm_verify_otp
description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT check connection status. Fails if OTP expired or incorrect.

name: jjm_get_connection_status
description: Checks household Functional Household Tap Connection (FHTC) status. Returns connection_status ('not_applied', 'applied', 'approved', 'installed', 'active', 'inactive'). PUBLIC tool — no authentication for general status. Does NOT apply for connection. Fails if household_id invalid or village not in JJM coverage.

name: jjm_apply_connection
description: Submits application for a new tap water connection. Transitions connection_status to 'applied'. Requires session_token. Infrastructure must be available or under construction in the village. Does NOT install connection. Fails if household already has active connection, duplicate application, or village has no infrastructure.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for personalized tools.

name: jjm_track_application_status
description: Tracks the application status for a new connection. Returns status with timeline. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify application. Fails if application_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for personalized tools.

name: jjm_get_supply_status
description: Returns current water supply_status ('unavailable', 'intermittent', 'available') for a household or village. Reflects real-world variability. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT guarantee continuous supply. Fails if household or village not registered.

household_id.description: Household ID. Optional — returns village level if omitted.

name: jjm_get_water_quality
description: Returns water quality_status ('unknown', 'safe', 'unsafe', 'under_testing') with parameters (potability, contamination). PUBLIC tool. Does NOT treat or purify water. Quality data may not be real-time. Fails if village not in testing coverage.

name: jjm_report_issue
description: Reports a water supply issue (no water, poor quality, leakage, etc.). Transitions complaint_status to 'raised'. Requires session_token. Connection must be 'installed' or 'active'. Does NOT resolve issue. Fails if no active connection, duplicate complaint, or invalid issue type.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for personalized tools.

name: jjm_track_complaint
description: Tracks complaint_status ('raised', 'in_progress', 'resolved', 'rejected'). Requires session_token. Does NOT raise new complaints. Fails if complaint_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for personalized tools.

name: jjm_get_infrastructure_status
description: Returns infrastructure_status ('not_available', 'under_construction', 'operational', 'maintenance') for a village. Includes pipeline, storage, and treatment plant info. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT apply for infrastructure. Fails if village invalid.

name: jjm_get_village_summary
description: Returns comprehensive village-level summary including total households, connections installed, coverage percentage, and supply status. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT modify data. Fails if village not found.

name: jjm_resolve_household_ambiguity
description: Resolves ambiguous household IDs or addresses. Returns possible matches. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT modify records. Fails if no matches found.

name: jjm_cancel_application
description: Cancels a connection application. Only when 'applied'. Requires session_token. Fails if already approved or installed.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for personalized tools.

name: jjm_raise_grievance
description: Raises JJM grievance. Categories: 'no_water_supply', 'poor_quality', 'connection_issue', 'delay_in_installation', 'infrastructure_problem'. Must check supply/connection status first. Requires session_token. Fails if category invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for personalized tools.

name: jjm_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks JJM grievance. Requires session_token. Fails if grievance_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for personalized tools.
